2609.09081.title: Everything in Moderation: Per-Domain Coverage Optima and Alignment-Resistant Domain Gaps in Multi-Domain Mid-Training
2609.09081.paper_summary: Mid-training, the stage between pre-training and alignment, is where a model's per-domain data composition is typically set by data availability rather than principled design. We ask what that decision buys, and whether a later alignment pass can undo it. In a controlled logical-reasoning setting (Qwen3-8B-Base, with a 4B replication; five semantically rule-disjoint KOR-Bench domains) we train 30 allocations spanning the five-domain simplex, 24 sweep configurations plus six withheld from the fit, at five seeds each. Three findings emerge. First, every domain has an interior coverage optimum: the moderate band ($10\%$-$40\%$) is best for all five domains, and a calibrated permutation test for quadratic interiority gives $P\approx0.010$; the fitted mid-training-only curves, with 8B peaks between $9.9\%$ and $35.1\%$, reproduce for curve shape but not peak location. Second, the gaps survive a fixed-budget alignment pass: compensatory SFT raises 116/120 cells (mean $+4.32\%$) yet bridges $0/240$ pairs at a $5\%$ threshold and $30/240$ at a $10\%$ ratio, an equal-budget uniform control behaves almost identically, and a permutation null would bridge $13.8\pm3.3$ and $77.9\pm8.5$ pairs ($P<0.001$). Third, zero coverage collapses mid-training-only accuracy, though a FineWeb-Edu-only control shows the collapse is commingled with generic drift. An exploratory $θ^*$ allocation attains the largest full-pipeline gain ($+4.36\%$ vs. $+0.80\%$/$+0.64\%$\,pp) but is marginal under Welch test.
2609.09081.paper_summary_zh: 中訓練階段，即預訓練與對齊之間的階段，通常是模型每個領域數據組成由數據可用性而非原則設計所決定的。我們詢問這一決策帶來了什麼，以及後續的對齊過程是否能夠撤銷它。在一個受控的邏輯推理環境中（Qwen3-8B-Base，具有4B複製；五個語義上不相交的KOR-Bench領域），我們訓練了30個分配，涵蓋五個領域的單純形，24個掃描配置加上六個從擬合中保留的，每個配置有五個隨機種子。三個發現浮現出來。首先，每個領域都有一個內部覆蓋最佳值：適中的範圍（$10\%$-$40\%$）對所有五個領域都是最佳的，對於二次內部性進行的校準置換測試給出了$P\approx0.010$；擬合的僅中訓練曲線，8B峰值介於$9.9\%$和$35.1\%$之間，曲線形狀再現但峰值位置不再現。其次，這些差距在固定預算的對齊過程中依然存在：補償性SFT提升了116/120個單元（平均$+4.32\%$），但在$5\%$閾值下橋接了$0/240$對，在$10\%$比率下橋接了$30/240$對，等預算的均勻控制幾乎表現相同，而置換無效則會橋接$13.8\pm3.3$和$77.9\pm8.5$對（$P<0.001$）。第三，零覆蓋會崩潰僅中訓練的準確性，儘管僅FineWeb-Edu控制顯示崩潰與一般漂移混合在一起。一個探索性的$θ^*$分配獲得了最大的全流程增益（$+4.36\%$對比$+0.80\%$/$+0.64\%$\,pp），但在Welch測試下邊際。
